workflow: Test whether an impaired CNS fatty acid shuttle is necessarily visible in peripheral carnitines.
evidence_basis: Results around Fig. 7, “common carotid arteries” and jugular samples: lower circulating C0 and C2, limited overlap with the central long-chain accumulation. Legend gives four-hour fasting and n=5.
Fig. 6 results describe brain distribution of elevated C16 and C18 species. The individual CNS-specific CPT2 model does not measure WWOX or a drug effect.
Fig. 1C,H,I and Results: oleate oxidation measured in P2 cortical astrocytes; glucose oxidation measured in cortex and glucose uptake in P2 astrocytes.
